fusions.name: Coiled Grip
fusions.desc: Coils around one enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stunning it for 1 second and silencing it for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spat Venom
fusions.desc: Spits venom at a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed the Skin
fusions.desc: Sheds your outer layer, removing up to 2 conditions from you and restoring 12 health.

fusions.name: Venom-Fed Scales
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
